m.aarti.tek: Perform the āratī of the youthful pair. Rādhe! Offer up your wealth for them.
m.aarti.pad1: The beauty of their faces is that of millions of suns and moons; seeing it, my heart is enticed.
m.aarti.pad2: Gazing at the fair face and the dark, the heart is enraptured; drink in the Lord's form with your eyes to the full.
m.aarti.pad3: A platter of gold and a wick of camphor; Hari has come, and the heart has become pure.
m.aarti.pad4: A bed of flowers, a garland of flowers; Nanda's darling sits on a jewelled throne.
m.aarti.pad5: The peacock crown and the flute in his hand look lovely; seeing him dressed as the finest of dancers, the heart is enchanted.
m.aarti.pad6: Half is clad in a blue sari, half in a yellow robe: this is Kuñjabihārī, the holder of the great mountain.
m.aarti.pad7: Śrī Puruṣottama, the holder of the great mountain: all the women of Vraja perform his āratī.
m.aarti.pad8: Nanda's darling and Vṛṣabhānu's young daughter, the lords of Paramānanda, are an unshakeable pair.
